scheme_name: Goggles by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
description:
The Goggles scheme is an initiative launched by the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department of the Government of India.

This scheme was officially launched in the year 2021.

The primary objective of the Goggles scheme is to provide specialized eyewear to individuals with visual impairments.

The scheme aims to enhance the quality of life for differently-abled individuals by improving their vision.

The Goggles scheme specifically targets individuals with low vision and other visual disabilities.

The scheme is designed to ensure that individuals with visual impairments can access appropriate visual aids.

The Goggles scheme provides financial assistance for the purchase of specialized goggles.

Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can receive financial support of up to ₹5,000.

This financial assistance is intended to cover the cost of specialized eyewear.

The Goggles scheme also aims to raise awareness about the importance of vision care among differently-abled individuals.

The scheme encourages the use of advanced technology in the production of specialized eyewear.

Eligibility for the Goggles scheme is primarily based on the degree of visual impairment.

Individuals with a visual acuity of less than 6/18 in the better eye are eligible for the scheme.

Applicants must provide a valid certificate of disability issued by a recognized authority.

The age limit for eligibility under this scheme is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There is no upper age limit specified for applicants.

Individuals must also meet certain income criteria to qualify for the Goggles scheme.

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹3 lakh per annum for the entire family.

The application process for the Goggles scheme is straightforward and user-friendly.

Interested individuals can apply online through the official website of the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department.

The application form must be filled out with accurate personal details.

Applicants are required to upload necessary documents during the application process.

These documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhaar card or voter ID.

A recent passport-sized photograph is also required.

The disability certificate must be uploaded as part of the application.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities.

Applicants can track the status of their application online.

The Goggles scheme has a specific timeline for disbursement of funds.

Once approved, the financial assistance is disbursed within 30 days.

The Goggles scheme is implemented by the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department at the state level.

Each state has its own designated nodal officer for the implementation of this scheme.

Contact details for the nodal officers can be found on the official website.

The Goggles scheme is part of a broader initiative to support differently-abled individuals in India.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for various welfare schemes for differently-abled individuals for the financial year 2021-2022.

The Goggles scheme is expected to benefit thousands of individuals across the country.

The scheme is aligned with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016.

This act emphasizes the need for accessibility and inclusion for differently-abled individuals.

The Goggles scheme also aims to promote self-reliance among beneficiaries.

By providing financial assistance for eyewear, the scheme empowers individuals to pursue education and employment opportunities.

The Goggles scheme is part of the government's commitment to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals.

Specifically, it addresses Goal 4 which focuses on inclusive and equitable quality education.

The Goggles scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries and advocacy groups.

Many individuals have reported significant improvements in their quality of life after receiving assistance.

The scheme also encourages collaboration with NGOs and civil society organizations.

These organizations play a crucial role in reaching out to potential beneficiaries.

The Goggles scheme is regularly monitored to ensure its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation of the scheme.

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform individuals about the availability of the Goggles scheme.

These campaigns are aimed at reaching marginalized communities.

The Goggles scheme is an example of the government's efforts to promote social justice.

It reflects the commitment to inclusivity and support for differently-abled individuals.

The Goggles scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at improving accessibility in India.

The government continues to explore innovative solutions to enhance the lives of differently-abled persons.

The Goggles scheme is a step towards creating a more inclusive society.

It highlights the importance of vision care and its impact on overall well-being.

The Goggles scheme is expected to evolve with advancements in technology.

Future enhancements may include the introduction of smart eyewear.

The Goggles scheme is a vital resource for individuals seeking to improve their vision.

It provides not only financial support but also hope for a better future.

The Goggles scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to welfare and empowerment.

Overall, the Goggles scheme is a significant initiative that addresses the needs of individuals with visual impairments in India.
